Itane?

really? is that so?

Other words

  • Ain' vērō? — do you really mean it?

    also used · classical · Traupman 103; Plaut.; Ter.

    The answer is Ajō.

Examples

  • Pater subjēcit: «Theodōrus mēcum fēcit.» «Ain' vērō?» inquit avus.

    Dad added, “Theo made it with me.” “Did he really?” said Grandpa.Libellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

See also why so?.
